research.limitations: Figures are vidIQ global estimates for the sampled terms. US-specific volumes were unavailable for these rows. The research did not measure hashtag reach or recommendation lift.
research.example_review: The restaurant scene matches Cherry Roosevelt, Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and slapstick comedy. Suggestions for Leslie Nielsen, Airplane!, Wrongfully Accused and stand-up comedy do not match the scene.
